title: Code of Virginia, Title 2.2 (Administration of Government), Chapter 39 - Virginia Human Rights Act
verified_how: fetched https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacode/title2.2/chapter39/ (HTTP 200): heading 'Chapter 39. Virginia Human Rights Act', listing s 2.2-3900 (Short title; declaration of policy), 2.2-3901 (Definitions), 2.2-3902, 2.2-3903 shown as 'Repealed', 2.2-3904 (Nondiscrimination in places of public accommodation), 2.2-3905 (Nondiscrimination in employment; definitions; exceptions), 2.2-3905.1, 2.2-3906 (Civil action by Attorney General), 2.2-3907 (Procedures for a charge of unlawful discrimination), 2.2-3908 (Civil actions by private parties) and 2.2-3909 - only s 2.2-3903 marked repealed, none marked '(Effective ...)'. Currency: the register's own 2026 Updates page (https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacodeupdates/) states 'this is a list of updated sections that took effect on July 1, 2026, unless otherwise noted', so the online Code reflects the 2026 session. The site marks future text as '(Effective <date>)' and dead text as 'Repealed', and the cited provisions carry neither marker. Note that article-level URLs such as /vacode/title40.1/chapter3/article2/ return HTTP 200 with an EMPTY content pane, so the citable register page for an article is its chapter page, which prints the article heading and its section list.
notes: Virginia employment is at will: there is NO Virginia statute requiring severance pay, notice of termination, or a mini-WARN filing, so no statute maps cleanly onto 'severance'. The Virginia Human Rights Act is the principal statute constraining termination, through s 2.2-3905 (unlawful discriminatory employment practices) and s 2.2-3908 (private causes of action); the older standalone unlawful-discharge cause of action at s 2.2-3903 is shown on the register as repealed and has been folded into ss 2.2-3905 and 2.2-3908. Related provisions verified elsewhere: Va. Code s 40.1-27.1 (discharge of employee for absence due to work-related injury prohibited) and s 40.1-27.3 (retaliatory action against employee prohibited) on the tit. 40.1 ch. 3 page. Wage replacement after separation is Title 60.2 ch. 6 (Benefits, ss 60.2-600 to 60.2-637), which I verified at https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacode/title60.2/chapter6/.
